understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT move the player through the board while gravity is active; with gravity DOWN, the player can fall vertically to lower available positions. CLICK removes a clickable tile but does not directly move the player. Spike tiles are hazards that end an attempt if landed on. Each level provides two attempts with up to 50 turns, and a failed attempt restarts the level. Undo functionality was not observed in the recent actions.
